title: Asus Prime Radeon RX 9070 EVO OC 16GB Graphics Card $849 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Umart
body:
Deal: Asus Prime Radeon RX 9070 EVO OC 16GB Graphics Card $849 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Umart

1080p gaming is good enough for now.
[nafis] how you know you spend too much time on ozbargain
[BalticBishop] What is the possible case for that? Nvidia AI advantages don't matter when you have no vram. Maybe some niche workflow but for gaming what a joke.
[Hydralyte] I bought a RX 9070 XT for $800 like 2 months ago through 10% off Mwave and Amex. wtf happened
[BennyHe2018] AMD and NVIDIA think AI is taking over everything and gamers can be trashed after milking the most profit.

To think i paid $729 for an XBOX Series X less than 2 years ago. And a PS5 for $629 around the same time, until i sold the PS5 and upgraded to a PS5 Pro.
[SkyeMG] @hollykryten: which models there's so many for ps5 atleast last i know.
different storage sizes etc
[Alleviate] As someone who only ever used consoles, I'm surprised how good the Ryzen 5 5600 + Radeon 9060 XT 16GB is. You definitely don't need this card to get PS5 Pro or better performance.
I'm playing games like Forza Horizon 6 in 4K with all settings on Ultra and hitting over 80fps just by having FSR4 set to Balanced with the Ryzen 5 5600 + Radeon 9060 XT 16GB combo. It looks and plays very well for the price.
[Morrii] @Alleviate: but lowkey even this isn't cheap. total for what I consider a bare minimum PC is like 1.3k, and when the parents are already strapped for cash and this doesn't include a desk or any peripherals. idk how anyone is supposed to afford this. ram GPU and ssd prices are absurd.
